name: io.github.shukoilab/web-research-mcp
title: Web Research MCP Server
description: Stealth Google Search and token-efficient web content extraction with undetected browser automation.

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP port for streamable MCP and health check endpoints (default: 3000)

environmentVariables.name: BROWSER_USER_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Persistent directory storing Chrome profile, cookies, and cache

environmentVariables.name: MAX_CONCURRENT_PAGES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum simultaneous browser tabs allowed by semaphore

environmentVariables.name: MAX_REQUESTS_BEFORE_RECYCLE
environmentVariables.description: Lifetime requests before background browser restart to prevent RAM fragmentation

environmentVariables.name: MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH
environmentVariables.description: Upper bound memory guard in bytes against massive HTML payloads

environmentVariables.name: NETWORK_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum wait time in ms for initial network stabilization before scrolling

environmentVariables.name: SCROLL_DELAY_MS
environmentVariables.description: Debounce delay in ms after each scroll and semantic unfolding step

environmentVariables.name: SCROLL_STEP_PX
environmentVariables.description: Distance in pixels per scroll increment

environmentVariables.name: SCROLL_SETTLE_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Final quiet period in ms after scroll loop completes

environmentVariables.name: MAX_SCROLL_STEPS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum scroll iterations for lazy content hydration and DOM convergence

environmentVariables.name: SEARCH_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum wait time in ms for Google SERP cards to render before parsing results

environmentVariables.name: READABILITY_CHAR_THRESHOLD
environmentVariables.description: Minimum character length for Mozilla Readability article scoring
